description: This file defines the 'Imap' class within the SuiteCRM project, serving as an IMAP wrapper that implements connection handling to an IMAP server via the 'imap_open()' function. It implements 'ImapInterface' and maintains the connection resource. The class includes properties and methods related to establishing an IMAP connection.

classes.name: Imap
classes.description: A wrapper class for IMAP email operations, implementing connection opening functionality within SuiteCRM.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Establishes an IMAP connection using imap_open() with the provided parameters, stores the resource, and returns it.
